signals.title: Holders ~31% underwater — and still not selling
signals.detail: MVRV 0.69: price is 31% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.537). Yet 61% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving. MVRV has risen 0.59→0.69 over ~30d.
signals.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
signals.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".
